intro: Boston's public sauna scene mixes old and new: Dillon's Russian Steam Bath in nearby Chelsea has operated since 1885, Kelo Spa & Steam in Newton Highlands runs a banya-style sauna built from Finnish kelo logs, and Moki runs Nordic-style social saunas with cold plunges in Allston and South Boston. Hours, men-only and women-only days, and seasonal changes vary, so confirm with each venue before you go.

venues.name: Moki Sauna South Boston
venues.drop_in_price: $59 per person for a Social Session (shared sauna, includes access to all saunas and cold plunges during the session); 1-hour sessions also available (price Unknown)
venues.session_length: Sessions typically last about 90 minutes plus changing time; 1-hour sessions also offered
venues.cold_plunge: Indoor cedar barrel cold plunge, plus additional outdoor plunges in the courtyard (included)
venues.schedule: Mon-Thu 5pm-9pm, Fri 4pm-8pm, Sat 9am-1pm, Sun 8am-8pm per the venue's footer. Reservations recommended; walk-ins based on availability. Quiet Hours (silent sessions) run Wednesday evenings and Sunday mornings.
venues.notes: Three traditional Nordic saunas, an indoor cedar-barrel plunge and an outdoor courtyard with its own sauna and plunge. Towels and sandals provided; bring a bathing suit (robes can be rented). Complimentary lockers. Private rentals (Cozy Cabin, Treehouse, Outdoor Sauna) are sold separately. Which of the saunas are wood-fired is Unknown.

venues.name: Moki Sauna Allston (Zone 3)
venues.drop_in_price: $59 per person for a Social Session (shared sauna, includes access to all saunas and cold plunges during the session); 1-hour sessions also available (price Unknown)
venues.session_length: Sessions typically last about 90 minutes plus changing time; 1-hour sessions also offered
venues.schedule: Mon/Wed/Thu 4pm-9pm, Fri 2pm-9pm, Sat 9am-9pm, Sun 9am-8pm per the venue's footer; Tuesday not listed. Reservations recommended; walk-ins based on availability. Quiet Hours (silent sessions) run Wednesday evenings and Sunday mornings.
venues.notes: Fully outdoor 'nordic sauna village' with two traditional Nordic saunas, a changing tent and lockers. Towels and sandals provided; bring a bathing suit. Private rentals (12-person wood-fired trailer, 8-person electric sauna) are sold separately.

venues.name: Kelo Spa & Steam
venues.drop_in_price: $69 per person for General Admission booked online (3 hours, includes robe and towel service); walk-ins without reservation $89 per person and availability is not guaranteed
venues.schedule: Banya hours: Mon 8:30am-9:15pm (men only), Tue 8:30am-9:15pm (women only), Wed-Fri 8:30am-9:15pm, Sat and Sun 7:45am-5:30pm plus 6pm-9pm. Gender policy on days other than Monday and Tuesday is Unknown.
venues.notes: Banya built from kelo timber logs imported from Lapland, Finland, plus steam room, lounge and juice bar. Extra paid services include platza, scrub and foam wash. Private 3-hour reservations start at $1,000 for up to 8 people.

venues.name: Dillon's Russian Steam Bath
venues.drop_in_price: $40 admission (2 hours); platza $24; oil rub $40 (30 min) or $60 (1 hour)
venues.schedule: Mon 2pm-9pm (women only); Tue-Fri 11am-9pm (men only); Sat 11am-8pm (men only); Sun 7am-1pm (men only).
venues.notes: Traditional Russian-style steam bath in business since 1885, with a high-heat steam chamber (the venue says nearly 180 degrees on the upper benches), a wet steam room, showers, lounge and snack bar. Parking behind the building on Cherry Street. Separate men's and women's days only; there are no co-ed hours listed.
